T: Chopsticks meet six-shooters. Both bring food.
D: An imperial guard heads to 1880s Nevada to rescue a kidnapped princess, with a smooth-talking outlaw in tow.
P: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy brawl in the saloon on the way to Carson City.
S: Steamed pork and prawn dumplings with soy and black vinegar
Pork and prawn dumplings with ginger and spring onion, pleated and steamed 8 minutes, with soy and black vinegar.
thin topside in soy, ginger, pepper and smoked paprika, oven-dried chewy, half Shanghai, half Nevada

Thin-sliced beef topside marinated in soy, ginger, five-spice, black pepper and smoked paprika, dried low in the oven until chewy. Half Shanghai, half Nevada. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick against the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 1 tsp five spice, 1 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
John Wayne? Chon Wang. Pan cornbread, honey butter.

Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, with honey butter. Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 220C oven. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter briefly. Pour in and bake 20 minutes. Serve with 60g butter beaten with honey.
M: Five spice pork ribs baked slow and glazed with hoisin and honey

Pork ribs rubbed with five-spice, brown sugar, garlic and salt, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with hoisin and honey under the grill. Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 2 tsp five spice, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 garlic cloves and salt. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 4 tbsp hoisin mixed with 2 tbsp honey and glaze under the grill.
Roy, buried to his chin, digs out with two chopsticks. Rump over hot coals, sticky mustard beans.

Rump steak seared over hot coals and sliced, with beans simmered slowly with bacon, onion, molasses and mustard until thick and sticky, and charred bread. Fry 200g diced bacon and an onion until golden. Add 2 drained 400g cans of cannellini beans, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp Dijon, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 300ml water and simmer 1 hour until thick. Season 2 large rump steaks, about 1kg, and sear over very hot coals or a grill pan for 4 minutes a side. Rest 5 minutes and slice. Serve with the beans and grilled crusty bread.
W: Chilled almond milk jelly cut in diamonds over lychees
Cool almond milk jelly cut into diamonds and served in a bowl with lychees and their syrup.
K: Rye whisky, honey, lemon and chilled jasmine tea topped with soda

Rye whisky stirred with cold jasmine tea, honey and lemon, poured long over ice and topped with soda. Half Shanghai, half Nevada. Steep 3 tsp jasmine tea in 400ml water just off the boil for 4 minutes, strain and chill. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp hot water to loosen. Fill four highball glasses with ice. Into each pour 45ml rye whisky, 100ml cold jasmine tea, 2 tsp honey syrup and 10ml lemon juice. Stir, top with soda water and add a strip of lemon peel.

s.note: Steamed pork and prawn dumplings with soy and black vinegar
s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, grated ginger and spring onion. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes. Serve with soy and black vinegar.
